mechanism.claim: Relative premium activity separates two high-volatility mechanisms. When premium activity is low relative to BTC variation, follow the spot-led move; when it is high, fade derivatives-heavy overreaction. Route the completed-day direction for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: completed BTC direction in the lower relative-activity tail and its negative in the upper tail
mechanism.why_distinct: HVPRAPR requires the lower tail of unsigned premium path activity jointly with the upper tail of BTC variation. It uses no premium sign/displacement, funding, OI, spot table, alt, fitted outcome, prior event clock, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC daily realized variation must rank at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily two-sided relative-premium-activity routing decision is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.premium_path: 1,440 exact unique bars_binance_premium BTCUSDT one-minute closes, finite signed values
features.premium_total_variation: sum(abs(close[i]-close[i-1])) over 1,439 within-day pairs, strict positive
features.btc_path: 288 exact coherent BTCUSDT five-minute aggregates from 1,440 one-minute rows over the same day
features.btc_return: log(final five-minute close/first five-minute open), strict nonzero
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared five-minute open-to-close log returns), strict positive
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks of relative premium activity and BTC variation over at most 270 earlier source-valid days, minimum 180; current excluded
features.relative_activity_tails: lower rank<=0.25 or upper rank>=0.75; middle ineligible
features.routing: lower tail follows btc_return; upper tail fades btc_return
features.eligible: source valid, either relative-activity tail, high BTC variation, and strict nonzero BTC return
features.availability: D 00:00 UTC after both source paths complete
features.side: sign(btc_return) in lower tail and -sign(btc_return) in upper tail

clock.decision: exact 00:00 UTC D after the completed source day
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.btc: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC aggregated to 5m
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, relative-activity tails, variation rank, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
